This '''person''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

At some point, the [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] brawler [[Tantor (bounty hunter)|Tantor]] became one of the crewmembers. Tantor intimidated victims of boarded ships, and stopped several attempted mutinies against the captain, but the captain repeatedly refused to raise Tantor's salary. Eventually, Tantor got sick of this and, during a discussion, the Esoomian put his captain in a [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and jettisoned the latter to space. [[Unidentified pirate first officer|The first officer]] of the ship became the new captain.
